model: CLEAN443 fixed Biot skeleton + kernel closure
equation: M_total ds/dt + A_total s + offset = normalized_body + normalized_well
state: s = absolute_SI_state / state_scales, field-major native-node ordering
spatial_grid: 101 by 101 native nodes, 5 m spacing, x-fast, 500 by 500 m
coefficients: First ten coefficient columns per equation are learned closure; remaining columns encode the fixed Biot prior
description: Frozen result used for the October 21 g=0.1 coefficient maps; distinct from historical g=0.001 comparison model
